patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff is changelog-only and does not touch the crashing number-splitting logic. The authoritative `42504907-fix` image instead changes `TranslateClause` to materialize two extra leading spaces in `number_buf` and to forward the first split chunk from `&number_buf[3]`, which genuinely satisfies the frozen left-context obligation and makes the protected look-behind probe run cleanly.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `pw >= &number_buf[3]` before the first split chunk is passed to `TranslateWord2()`
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `TranslateClause()` rewrites a long numeric token into `number_buf`, the first split chunk must not be dispatched until `pw` points at or beyond `&number_buf[3]`, so `TranslateNumber_1()` will have two bytes of valid left context before it evaluates `word[-2]` and `word[-3]` on that chunk.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable split-number loop forwards its first chunk from `&number_buf[1]`, leaving only one byte of left padding before the chunk even though the downstream previous-thousands test looks back three bytes from `word`. The authoritative fixed image stages two extra prefix bytes and dispatches the first chunk from `&number_buf[3]` instead.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace records `split_number_dispatch.pw` two bytes before `split_number_dispatch.safe_first_chunk_start` while `previous_thousands_probe` executes, so the required predicate is violated at the root site on the crashing run. The authoritative fixed-image trace records `pw == safe_first_chunk_start` and still reaches `previous_thousands_probe`, making the same source-level obligation genuinely satisfied.

nodes.description: At the sink event, `TranslateNumber_1()` has reached the `n_digits == group_len` previous-thousands path and is immediately about to evaluate `word[-2]` / `word[-3]` on the forwarded first split chunk.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `ASSERT_EVT point=previous_thousands_probe word=...` at the look-behind site, and that event is emitted only on the `n_digits == group_len` path immediately before the source-level `word[-2]` / `word[-3]` probe.

edges.relation: The first split-chunk pointer `pw` is forwarded unchanged through `TranslateWord2` / `TranslateWord` and arrives at `TranslateWord3` as `word1` on the numeric-dispatch path.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `split_number_dispatch.pw == numeric_dispatch.word1`, proving the same chunk pointer reaches the numeric dispatch event.

edges.relation: The same numeric chunk pointer dispatched as `word1` in `TranslateWord3` is passed unchanged through `TranslateNumber()` into `TranslateNumber_1()` as `word` at the previous-thousands look-behind probe.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `numeric_dispatch.word1 == previous_thousands_probe.word`, so the exact first split chunk is the one consumed at the sink event.
